title: The Playground in Spring and Winter
text:
In spring, the children go to the playground after school. They play on the slide and the swings. The sun is warm and the grass is green. Tom likes the swings the most.

In winter, the playground is cold and quiet. Some children wear hats and gloves. They build a snowman near the big tree. Then they go home to drink hot tea.

questions.text: When do the children go to the playground after school?
What do the children build in winter?
Why do the children wear hats and gloves in winter?
Why do the children probably like going to the playground in spring?
options: The weather is nice for playing outside
The playground is closed in spring

vocabulary.definition: an outdoor area where children go to play
seats hung from ropes that children move back and forth
a figure made of snow, shaped like a person

paragraph_translations: Навесні діти після школи ходять на дитячий майданчик. Вони граються на гірці та на гойдалках. Сонце тепле, а трава зелена. Томові найбільше подобаються гойдалки.
Взимку дитячий майданчик холодний і тихий. Деякі діти носять шапки і рукавиці. Вони ліплять сніговика біля великого дерева. Потім вони йдуть додому пити гарячий чай.
